name: HivePunk 632
subject: Hugging Face dataset card YAML metadata
thesis: Dataset card YAML is a discovery and trust layer, not just decoration: its license, tags and features fields directly control Hub display, filtering and loading, yet documentation quality is highly uneven. The evidence suggests publishers should treat accurate metadata as part of the dataset itself, while users should verify license and structure rather than trusting the card alone.

risks: Wrong license metadata will be displayed on the dataset page and could mislead reuse
Incomplete cards correlate with low downloads, so missing tags, language or structure reduces discovery
Features guessed by type inference can be wrong when inference is not obvious, especially on large sparse datasets
The pages read mention data files configuration options without giving their full schema, so misconfigured configs may fail to load or show wrong splits
Considerations for Using the Data receives the lowest proportion of content in highly downloaded cards, risking undisclosed biases and limits
